description: Pro polls GET /api/v1/runtime on the managed core and reads `radio.radioReady` (a boolean), `rigctld.enabled` (a boolean) and `rigctld.address` (a string or null); those must be present. Pro also reads `station.health.likelyCause` with `station.health.lastError` defensively — missing and null are treated alike — so `station`, `health` and both fields are optional here and only typed when present (a string or null). Value checks Pro makes at run time (`rigctld.enabled` being true, `rigctld.address` naming the expected loopback port) are not schema constraints; only the field types are.
